description: Shell script for running tests and managing patches for a C++ software project, including patch application, environment setup, building, and testing steps.

methods.name: apply_patch_idempotent
methods.description: Applies a patch idempotently by performing dry-runs and ensuring the patch is either applied or already present without creating reject files.

methods.name: ensure_thundertools_expected_revision
methods.description: Resets ThunderTools to a specific git revision to ensure a consistent baseline before patching.

methods.name: run_build_and_l1_tests
methods.description: Configures, builds, and runs L1 tests for the project using CMake and CTest.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point orchestrating patch application, environment setup, build, and test execution.
